visual_inspection.reviewer: paper implementation agent; model-assisted visual inspection, not human review
method: Rendered all 22 exact-final pages at 1400-pixel long dimension.
All 22 preceding-candidate page layouts were inspected in six contact sheets, plus full-size pages 11 and 20.
Compared every final page PNG with that inspected predecessor; 21 are byte-identical, and only page 11 changed.
Inspected exact-final page 11 at full size: the A04 annotation is above-left of its point and clear of the bottom axis.
Measured actual embedded text sizes and page-bound containment with PyMuPDF.
visual_inspection.finding: The A04 annotation/axis contact identified by root is corrected. No materially cropped or unreadable figure/table was identified in the inspected render. Short figure keys join complete source tables; appendix tables follow introductory section headings as LaTeX floats.
limitations: Contact-sheet inspection checks overall layout and is not line-by-line visual proofreading of every word.
A rendering or font check is not semantic, speaker, ASR or scientific validation.

scope: Local artifact verification, not human review or venue-compliance certification.
